description: Change of use from C3 to C4 HMO (Application for a Certificate of Lawful Development for an Existing Development)
decision_conditions: The existing use does not constitute Lawful Development under Section 191 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended, as the applicant has failed to demonstrate, on the balance of probabilities, that the property was in continuous use as a Class C4 House in Multiple Occupation by at least three unrelated individuals prior to the implementation of the borough-wide Article 4 Direction on 11/12/2025, which removed permitted development rights under Class L, Part 3 of Schedule 2 to the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015. Insufficient corroborative evidence has been submitted to substantiate the tenancy history and continuity of occupation claimed and therefore the lawful use has not been established.
